                MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE

                        (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India)

                             NOTIFICATION

                         New Delhi, the 14th June, 2016

        F. No. 15-03/Enf/FSSAI/2014.—Whereas the draft Food Safety and Standards (Food Products
Standards and Food Additives) Third Amendment Regulations, 2016, were published as required by
sub- section (1) of section 92 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (34 of 2006), vide notification of the
Food Safety and Standards Authority of India number F. No. 15-03/Enf/FSSAI/2014, dated the 1st April,
2016, in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part III, Section 4, inviting objections and suggestions from the
persons likely to be affected thereby, before the expiry of the period of thirty days from the date on which the
copies of the Official Gazette containing the said notification were made available to the public;

      And whereas the copies of the said Gazette were made available to the public on the 12th April, 2016;

      And whereas the objections and suggestions received from the public in respect of the said draft
regulations have been considered by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India;

      Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (e) of sub- section (2) of section 92 read
with section 16 of the said Act, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India hereby makes the following
regulations further to amend the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives)
Regulations, 2011, namely:—

                                          Regulation

1. Short title and commencement.—(1) These regulations may be called the Food Safety and Standards
(Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Third Amendment Regulations, 2016.

     (2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette.

2.      In the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011,
        in regulation 2.2, in sub-regulation 2.2.1,-

         (a) in clause 2, for the words and figures, “Iodine value 98 to 112”, the words and figures “Iodine
           value 98 to 123” shall be substituted;

        (b) in clause 24, after item 4(ii), the following item shall be inserted, namely :-


        “(iii) Blended with physically refined      Not more than 4.0 percent by weight; provided
              rice bran oil                             that oryzanol content be minimum of 0.20% (by
                                                weight) with rice bran oil at 20% level and with
                                             an increment of 0.05% with every 5% rise in
                                                        rice bran oil content in the blend.”


                                  PAWAN AGARWAL, Chief Executive Officer

                                                         [ADVT. III/4/Exty./136(187)]

Note. - The principal regulations were published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part III, Section 4 vide
        notification number F. No. 2-15015/30/2010, dated the 1st August, 2011 and subsequently amended
        vide notification numbers:
          (i)    F. No. 4/15015/30/2011, dated the 7th June, 2013;
           (ii)    F. No. P. 15014/1/2011-PFA/FSSAI, dated the 27th June, 2013;
           (iii)   F. No. 5/15015/30/2012, dated the 12th July, 2013;
